rows.grounds: coordinating particle linking items in the enumeration
compound of sva (own), śiras (head), and chedana (cutting); neuter action noun
noun denoting death, presented in apposition or as the culminating result

items.question: Which acts of royal consecration and self-decapitation culminating in death are included in this enumeration?
premises: Royal consecration is named as an included act.
The cutting of one's own head is named as an included act.
Death is stated in connection with this self-decapitation.
items.inference: The enumeration includes royal consecration together with self-decapitation resulting in death.
uncertainties: Whether mṛtiḥ functions as a separate enumerated item or as an appositive result of svaśiraśchedanaṃ is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: Royal consecration, and the cutting off of one's own head—death.
